apps/web/src/marketing/home/journey-fx.t.reason: EvryBot's mood at each stop of the home journey: it talks for 1.3 s after arriving, then smiles for 1.6 s when the line is about a task, then goes idle. The two waits are the choreography the visitor sees, not an ordering patch; a new arrival clears them, and reduced motion skips them.

Starts the walk between two stops: EvryBot follows the curved path frame by frame (getPointAtLength on the measured trail, 0.7 to 1.7 s by distance) and the walked line grows under it; each frame is the animation itself.
The next frame of the same walk; the loop ends on arrival, on a new walk, on a relayout, or when the walker is gone.
